server_configuration: OpenSSL s_server -tls1_3 -groups X25519:X25519MLKEM768 -www; no client authentication or authorization
trust: ephemeral self-signed localhost certificate explicitly supplied to client
ordering: hybrid, classical, classical, hybrid; two blocks of 50 attempts per mode
sample_count_rationale: 100 per mode rather than 1000: each process took about 1 second; 1000 per mode would take approximately 35 minutes. p95/p99 are exploratory only.
measurement_scope: perf_counter_ns around verify_tls_group: process startup, TCP, TLS, certificate verification, output capture, shutdown and parsing; not isolated handshake latency
source_state: Measured at HEAD 5e5f952 with uncommitted session-telemetry changes. A subsequent verifier fix only clears verification flags on failed connections; all 200 measured connections had succeeded.
